page_title: BET 1-0 ALA | Betis v Alaves 22/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Pablo Garcia (Betis) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90+5' OFF THE BAR! Cedric Bakambu (Betis) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!

90+4' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
90+3' Pablo Garcia (Betis) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post.
90+1' Mariano Diaz (Alaves) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
89' That will be all from Antonio Blanco who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lander Pinillos Wilson (Alaves).
86' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Giovani Lo Celso is replaced by Valentin Gomez (Betis).
85' Substitution. Cucho Hernandez is replaced by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
85' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
84' Facundo Garces (Alaves) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
84' The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
83' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
83' Jonny Otto (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
82' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Antonio Sivera.
81' Betis are awarded a mid-range free kick.
81' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Antonio Blanco (Alaves) duly receives a yellow card.
80' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
78' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Facundo Garces (Alaves) was quite harsh and Miguel Ortiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Victor Parada walks off the pitch to be replaced by Calebe (Alaves).
76' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
75' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Betis was in an offside position.
74' The attendance is 54646.
73' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) replaces Junior Firpo.
68' A cross from a corner kick by Betis is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
67' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' Pablo Garcia (Betis) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Antonio Sivera makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
64' The free kick is taken by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves). His attempt from close range towards the right post is thwarted by the goalkeeper who makes a great save.
63' Alaves are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
63' Hector Bellerin (Betis) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.

61' Hector Bellerin (Betis) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Antonio Sivera guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rodrigo Riquelme departs the field of play to be replaced by Pablo Garcia (Betis).
58' Eduardo Coudet decides to make a substitution. Pablo Ibanez will be replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mariano Diaz (Alaves) comes onto the pitch so that Toni Martinez can be given a rest.
58' Here comes a substitution. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is brought on as a substitute for Jon Guridi.
58' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

56' Jonny Otto (Alaves) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
54' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Cucho Hernandez (Betis) but poses no threat.
53' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is caught offside!
52' Half-chance! Junior Firpo (Betis) plays a pass into the box, but Antonio Sivera reacts well to snuff out the attack.
51' Carles Alena (Alaves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
50' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The yellow card is received by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Betis have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
45+2' A pass by Pablo Fornals (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
43' Total attempts – 8:6.
42' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) is yellow-carded.
40' The ball goes behind for a corner. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' Carles Alena (Alaves) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
35' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
32' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
30' The referee blows for a cooling break.
28' Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
26' One of the players from Alaves times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
23' The foul by Aitor Ruibal (Betis) was seen by Miguel Ortiz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
21' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
16' 1 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:0.
14' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
14' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
11' The ball is cleared after Jon Guridi (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

10' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Antonio Sivera, who makes a glorious save!
8' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
6' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

3' Pau Lopez pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Jon Guridi (Alaves) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
3' Jon Guridi (Alaves) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
2' The free kick from long range, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

The players are out at last! Alaves will take the kick-off.
